description: 阿拉伯杀：精彩的引入弃子攻杀
explanation_en: A brilliant decoy sacrifice leads into Arabian mate. The source annotation contains no individual move popups.

intro.popup: 💡 阿拉伯杀：精彩的引入弃子攻杀！多熟悉这种棋形和思路。
intro.popup_en: 💡 Arabian mate: A brilliant decoy sacrifice leads to the mating attack. Become familiar with this pattern and idea.

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：精彩的引入弃子攻杀，多熟悉这种棋形和思路。车马配合将死角落的王是阿拉伯杀的核心。
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: This decoy sacrifice creates a mating attack. The core of Arabian mate is the rook and knight working together to trap the king in the corner.
